desc: Analyze the problem and identify that it is a maximum weight non-crossing matching problem.
Determine that an $O(N^2)$ DP solution is too slow for $N \le 3 \times 10^5$.
Hypothesize and verify a greedy strategy: always remove the adjacent pair with the maximum absolute difference.
Implement the greedy strategy using a priority queue to always pick the maximum adjacent pair.
Handle the linked list structure to efficiently find neighbors and update the sequence.
Use a boolean array or similar to track removed elements.
